summary: Full regression sweep on Indian Rounds Travel CRM. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass across auth (admin/sales/ops), users, allocations, leads, notifications, notes, contact events, reassign, followups, supplier-mail preview, master, AI, dashboard, PWA static. Frontend: End-to-end UI verified for login (with Google button), sidebar (Indian Rounds logo + role-based nav), bell + popover with unread badge (2 alerts), Dashboard on '/' (8 KPI cards draggable + persisted in localStorage 'ir_kpi_order_*', Supplier Operations summary card with 7 metrics, Task Timer with live countdown 'Due in Xh Ym Zs'), Leads list (row-call-*/row-wa-* quick actions on every row), Lead Detail (contact-panel, contact-timeline, lead-notes with add/list, followup-countdown live text, qa-call/whatsapp/sms/email/reassign, reassign-dialog with select+save, supplier-tracker only on leads that already sent supplier mail, follow-up input type=datetime-local), New Lead validations (10-digit phone → f-phone-err, duplicate phone → dup-block-dialog with open-existing-lead + force-create-lead visible only for admin, dynamic child-ages-section 0/1 fields based on children count), Users page allocations-section with u-consultant field, Calendar month grid with 31 cal-day-* cells, AI Assistant runs itinerary (3147 chars response) and quote endpoints, PWA manifest.json + sw.js reachable. RBAC verified: sales user sees no /users, /master, /suppliers, /activity nav and /users route redirects out.
passed: Backend: all 27 pytest cases PASS (auth, users, allocations, leads, dup-check, notifications, notes CRUD, contact-events CRUD, reassign RBAC, followups upcoming, supplier-mail preview HTML, master, AI itinerary + quote, dashboard stats, PWA static)
Login page: Google button visible + branded logo image renders
Login flow: admin/sales/ops all authenticate; redirect to '/' (dashboard)
Sidebar: sales user hidden from nav-users/nav-master/nav-suppliers/nav-activity; admin sees all
Bell popover opens with 2 unread badge showing on bell-btn

Dashboard '/': 8 kpi cards, draggable=true, localStorage key ir_kpi_order_<userId> persisted; Supplier Operations Response Tracker card with Sent Today / Awaiting / Quotes Today / Overdue / Need F/UP / Avg Reply / No-Email Supp; Task Timer widget shows IR07001 Aarav Test with 'Due in 1h 32m 14s' live
Lead list: row-call-{leadId} + row-wa-{leadId} data-testids present on every row (19 each)

Lead Detail (IR07001): contact-panel, contact-timeline, lead-notes, followup-countdown ('Due in 1h 36m 40s') all present; qa-call/whatsapp/sms/email/reassign all rendered; reassign-dialog opens with reassign-select + reassign-save; note-input + note-add adds and persists ('TEST_UI_note_regression' visible after add); follow-up input is type='datetime-local'
Lead Detail with supplier mail sent (IR07005): supplier-tracker card renders with 1 tracker row

New Lead form: submitting phone='12345' shows [data-testid=f-phone-err]; submitting duplicate phone='9876543210' opens dup-block-dialog with open-existing-lead + force-create-lead buttons (admin); setting children=2 dynamically renders child-ages-section with f-child-age-0 + f-child-age-1
Users page (admin): allocations-section Card rendered with u-consultant input
Calendar: month grid renders 31 cal-day-* cells for July 2026
AI Assistant: destination=Bali → run-itinerary returns 3147 chars markdown itinerary

minor.issue: Response shape is {matches: [...]}, but a 'duplicate' or 'exists' boolean flag would simplify the consumer contract; current UI works fine but consumers must check matches.length.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning 'validateDOMNesting: <a> cannot appear as a descendant of <a>' fires on every page load — likely NavLink nested inside another anchor. Cosmetic hydration warning but pollutes logs.

Console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' repeatedly on dashboard load — indicates a ResponsiveContainer child rendered before layout measures. Not user-visible but noisy.
Radix Dialog missing 'Description' or aria-describedby prop — a11y warning. Cosmetic.

issues: Legacy note from iteration_6: both 'Kerala' + 'KERALA' still present. Consider normalising master values to Title Case.
No data-testid on the output/response area — makes automation harder to assert on the AI text (had to fall back to body.innerText length).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1339 lines and mixes route handlers + models + seeders in a single file — should be split (e.g., routers/{auth,leads,suppliers,notes,ai}.py + models.py + seeds.py) once feature freeze is complete.
NoteCreate/ContactEvent Pydantic models are defined mid-file, not with other models at top — small refactor for consistency.

Duplicate _phone_10_digit validator in LeadCreate accepts numbers but LeadUpdate.phone does NOT validate — allows updating a lead with an invalid phone via PATCH /leads/{id}. Consider reusing the same validator.
AI endpoints return {content: str} but the test_report_link (Playwright) had to guess the key name; documenting shape in Pydantic response_model or an OpenAPI response schema would help.
clean_doc mutates dict in place; safe here because it is only called on freshly fetched Mongo docs, but easy to hit if reused.

seed_data_creation: Added 1 lead-note 'TEST_UI_note_regression' on IR07001 and 1 contact-event 'TEST_regression_call' on the first lead via pytest. All test data prefixed TEST_ for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is in excellent shape. Backend regression harness lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 27 tests, ~30s runtime, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Dashboard route is '/' (there is NO /dashboard route — my initial test hit that 404 blank page bug and got confused; nav-dashboard link correctly points to '/'). Lead list quick-actions use row-call-{leadId}/row-wa-{leadId} data-testids (not qa-*). Contact-panel qa-* testids are on Lead Detail only. Supplier tracker only renders on leads with mail_status='Sent' (e.g., IR07003, IR07005). Follow-up countdown works and updates every second. All console warnings are cosmetic; no runtime errors.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue found. The three cosmetic warnings (validateDOMNesting <a>-in-<a>, Recharts 0×0, DialogContent missing description) are non-breaking React/Radix warnings and do not affect functionality — see action_items.
